_comment: Copy to fm_extract.config.json, fill in, restrict permissions to the service account, and keep out of any synchronised folder. The script looks for a config named after itself, so renaming the script renames the config it expects.
_tables_comment: One entry per source table. staging_table may be omitted: it defaults to the lnd schema with the same table name. The columns list is PINNED, deliberately - it was derived from which fields carry data, which is right for establishing the list and wrong as a standing arrangement, because a field empty today and used from next month would otherwise never be extracted and nothing would signal it. Re-run the fill-rate profile periodically and amend this list as a deliberate act.
_columns_note: Generate the real list from the staging table: SELECT string_agg('"' || column_name || '"', E',\n' ORDER BY ordinal_position) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='stg' AND table_name='pp' AND column_name <> 'loaded_at';
